name: file-tree
description: An IDE-style file tree that shows what Claude reads, edits and commits, with git status, search and a file preview

style.title: Style
style.description: How the tree looks: ide (icons, guides, git letters), minimal (quiet, dots), rich (line counts, ages, Claude status line). The ◐ button in the pane cycles it too.

previewLayout.title: Preview layout
previewLayout.description: replace: the preview fills the pane; split: the tree on top, the preview below

openWith.title: Open with
openWith.description: Command the ↗ button runs on a file: {path} is the file, {dir} its folder; without {path} the path goes last. Runs without a shell. Empty: the default app.

followClaude.title: Follow Claude
followClaude.description: on: scroll the tree to the file Claude reads, edits or commits

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd needs a Nerd Font in the terminal; unicode works everywhere
